concerns.text: The plan cites the American Gut Project (AGP) and the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) as the two primary datasets and attempts to link them probabilistically. Public releases of AGP and HRS have no shared participant identifiers, making reliable linkage infeasible. Relying on a probabilistic match that is expected to yield < 200 participants (and aborting if it does) means the core research question—correlating gut microbiome composition with cognitive scores in the same individuals—cannot be answered with these datasets. A dataset that already contains paired microbiome and cognitive assessments is required.

Constitution Principle VI mandates that microbiome taxonomic tables be obtained *directly* from the American Gut Project via the Qiita/EBI repository. The plan instead downloads AGP data from a HuggingFace mirror, which violates the constitution’s provenance requirement. The source must be changed to the official Qiita/EBI endpoint or the constitution must be amended.
